text: This report requests that City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one City-owned tree located at 157 Brookside Avenue. The application indicates the reason for removal is to construct a parking pad. The subject tree is a Colorado blue spruce (Picea pungens), measuring 39 cm in diameter. The Tree By-laws do not support the removal of this tree as it is healthy and maintainable.
City Council on December 15, 16 and 17, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council deny the request for a permit to remove one City-owned tree located at 157 Brookside Avenue.
